items.t: BlackBerry (TSX:BB) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Its 147% Rebound
items.sum: BlackBerry has delivered a sharp multi‑year rebound, which puts a fresh spotlight on whether the current share price lines up with the cash flows the business can realistically generate. With investors now paying much closer attention to its software and licensing story, the key issue is how that renewed enthusiasm compares with the intrinsic value suggested by its cash flow profile.
